headlines.title: Women with autoimmune diseases often have symptoms dismissed as ‘psychological’
headlines.description: Women with autoimmune diseases such as lupus or rheumatoid arthritis are more likely to be misdiagnosed or get delayed treatment compared with men, with their symptoms often dismissed as “psychological.”

headlines.title: U.S. measles deaths rise to 10 after new reports in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin
headlines.description: Total measles deaths in the United States this year rose to 10 on Friday, a grim milestone in an outbreak that has seen a record number of infections and prompted state and local health departments to ramp up vaccination efforts.

headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: U.S. loses measles-elimination status, WSJ reports
headlines.description: The U.S. lost its coveted measles elimination status, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The Pan American Health Organization is scheduled to announce the decision after over 5,400 cases have been reported nationwide. NBC News’ Berkeley Lovelace Jr. details what it would take for the U.S. to regain its status.

headlines.title: Tips and Products to Keep Your Skin Healthy During the Holidays
headlines.description: The holiday season means travel, parties and a few late nights so Sabrina Elba, a licensed esthetician and co-founder of S’able Labs, joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to share her holiday skin care survival guide. Products include a Biodance collagen peptide serum mist, a Sofie Pavitt therapy mask duo, Peach Slices snail rescue eye gel and more.

headlines.title: Stacking Skin Care: The Correct Order for Applying Products
headlines.description: With so many options and ingredients, it can be hard to know the right way to stack up your skin care. TODAY contributor and board-certified dermatologist Dr. Michelle Henry explains how actives work, the best combinations to use and the proper order for applying them.
